scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/remove-build-secrets.mjs
scripts.build:staging: npm run typecheck && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging vite build && node scripts/remove-build-secrets.mjs
scripts.build:production: npm run typecheck && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production vite build && node scripts/remove-build-secrets.mjs
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:production && wrangler deploy --env production --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply character-taste-lab-current-local --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply character-taste-lab-v2-staging --remote --env staging --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.contracts: npm run assets:check && npm run contracts:ddl && npm run contracts:schemas && npm run contracts:openapi
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run contracts && npm run architecture:check && npm run licenses:check && npm run build && npm run secret:scan && npm run bundle:budget && npm run test:e2e
